clue.text: Left port with cargo aboard

parts.note: Aden is a port city in Yemen

explanation.surface: A ship departs harbour fully loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A loaded ship is weighed down with its freight, which is the sense of the old past participle of lade.

clue.text: Clear to me anyhow that he arrives after the due time

definitions.text: he arrives after the due time

indicators.note: anyhow means in a haphazard way, so the letters of the three words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that a person turning up past the deadline is plain enough to them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyhow' rearranges the nine letters of CLEAR TO ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who turns up tardy, after the expected hour, is described by this compound noun.

clue.text: Imagined being asleep

definitions.meaning: fancied or pictured something in the mind

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both fancying something while awake and having visions during slumber.

clue.text: Tidy stock

definitions.meaning: an old word for cattle, livestock

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means orderly; as a noun it is an archaic term for oxen or cattle kept as livestock.

clue.text: Young and inexperienced having only just washed?

definitions.meaning: taken literally, someone fresh from a wash still has damp patches on the head

explanation.surface: Someone is both green in experience and fresh from the bath.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for naivety pictures a newborn still damp; read literally it describes anyone just out of the bath.

clue.text: Asserting Ron's produced an in, infringement

indicators.note: produced is read as made into something new, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive apostrophe is no letter, giving the letters as written

explanation.surface: Ron's assertive claim turns out to break a rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produced' rearranges the thirteen letters of ASSERTING RONS; the words 'an in,' appear to be a printing glitch and act only as link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking a law or rule is a violation, a crossing of the line set down.

clue.text: Detailed animal shows impetuosity

indicators.note: read as de-tailed, the animal loses its last letter

parts.note: an eland is a large African antelope

explanation.surface: A minutely described creature displays rash eagerness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' surface-reads as finely described; cryptically it means cut off the tail, so ELAND drops its D.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash and spirited verve, a flair carried out with vigour, overlap with impetuous energy.

clue.text: One's to post one to a Moslem

parts.note: one is I, and one's stands for one is, giving I and S
to post a letter is to mail it
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone's job is to send a letter to a follower of Islam.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a member of a Shia branch of Islam, followers of the Aga Khan.

clue.text: Very many kept cool and gambled

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
iced means chilled or kept cold

explanation.surface: A crowd stayed calm while betting.
explanation.walkthrough: Roman numerals such as D (500) are often clued as a big number.
explanation.definitionFit: To play at dice is to wager, so the verb means gambled.

clue.text: See 4
The wretch stumbled in and died totally unclad!

annotationWithheld.why: The wretch stumbled in and died totally unclad! (8,5): no parse of these words builds the thirteen letters; the clue appears garbled in OCR and no source gives the printed text
annotationWithheld.clue: The wretch stumbled in and died totally unclad!

clue.text: Ian came round looking pale and sickly

indicators.note: came round suggests turning about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ian recovered consciousness but looked wan and ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' rearranges IAN CAME; 'came round' sounds like waking up.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking red blood cells leaves a person wan and weak, which is what this adjective describes.

clue.text: Fortified site used by holiday makers

definitions.meaning: a military encampment or ancient earthwork
a place of tents or chalets for vacationers

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an army's defended base and a holiday site of tents or cabins.

clue.text: Do not start to strain the lock

indicators.note: tells us to drop the opening letter of the word for strain

parts.note: stress means strain or pressure

explanation.surface: Advice not to tug hard at a door fastening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do not start' removes the first S of STRESS; 'the lock' is a lock of hair, not a door fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A long curl or ringlet of hair is a lock.

clue.text: Understanding type

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means gentle and sympathetic; as a noun it means sort or class.

clue.text: Availing oneself of American gin cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters of gin are mixed

explanation.surface: Someone helps themselves to a mixed drink from the States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' mixes GIN into ING after US.
explanation.definitionFit: Employing or making use of something is to avail oneself of it.

clue.text: Bridge partners are in a trap

parts.note: in bridge South and North play as a partnership, abbreviated S and N

explanation.surface: Two card players find themselves caught.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, North and South are partners, as are East and West.
explanation.definitionFit: A noose or wire for catching small animals is a gin or snare-type trap.

clue.text: The way of working is not in English

definitions.text: The way of working is not in English

parts.words: The way of working is not in English
parts.note: a method of operating, expressed in a phrase borrowed from Latin rather than English

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase literally means method of operating, used of a criminal's habits or any routine.

clue.text: Distinguished record by Ernest and Edmund

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
Ern is a short form of Ernest
Ed is a short form of Edmund

explanation.surface: Two men named Ernest and Edmund make a notable recording.
explanation.definitionFit: To make out or tell apart is to perceive, the verb sense here.

clue.text: What happens during a famine? Protests in jail possibly

definitions.meaning: read literally, the lack of food hits people
refusals to eat by prisoners as a form of protest

explanation.surface: A famine's effects set beside prison protests.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, starvation attacks people; the phrase normally names a protest by fasting.

clue.text: Many changing in hotel disheartened on Sunday by songbooks

indicators.note: with its heart removed, only the first and last letters of hotel remain
the letters of many change their order

explanation.surface: Lots of people swap rooms in a hotel, gloomy on Sunday among the church books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' leaves H and L of HOTEL; 'changing' turns MANY into YMNA, which goes 'in' between them, then S.
explanation.definitionFit: Books of hymns are collections of sacred songs used in church services.

clue.text: The basic idea of a tonic

definitions.meaning: the central theme of a speech or plan
in music the tonic is the first note of a scale

explanation.definitionFit: It is the central theme of a speech and, in music, the first degree of the scale on which a key is based.

clue.text: Discourage although only slightly wet

definitions.meaning: to dull or deaden enthusiasm, as in to dampen spirits

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means deaden or dull someone's spirits; as an adjective it means moist.

clue.text: Untidy study needs spring cleaning?

indicators.note: spring suggests jumping about and cleaning a reshuffle, so the letters of study are moved around

explanation.surface: A messy home office is due for a seasonal tidy-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A room covered in grime and unswept is neglected and messy.

clue.text: It can become a lark

indicators.note: become signals the letters turn into something else, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Something could turn into a songbird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become' rearranges IT CAN; 'lark' is a prank, not the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A caper or playful prank is a bit of fun, a lark.

clue.text: Dishonest-sounding musical instrument

indicators.note: sounding tells us the word is spoken, a homophone

parts.note: a dishonest person is a liar

explanation.surface: An instrument with a shady-sounding reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: A small harp of ancient Greece is a stringed instrument.

clue.text: About four, I in France dance

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: je is French for I
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Around four o'clock, someone in France takes to the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively swing dance to jazz music is a form of ballroom dancing.

clue.text: Stumped by record pace

parts.note: ST is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for stumped
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A puzzled person moves on beside a record.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman is out stumped when the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while they are out of their ground; scorecards abbreviate it ST.
explanation.definitionFit: A single stride is a pace.

clue.text: Unwell in the main

parts.note: in the main seems to mean mostly, but the main is the open ocean, so this is illness at sea

explanation.definitionFit: Nausea caused by a ship's motion on the ocean is this ailment.

clue.text: Experienced being at least two days old

definitions.text: being at least two days old
definitions.meaning: read literally, anyone born before the day before today

explanation.surface: Worldly wisdom and an age of two days or more set side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means not gullible; taken literally it means one was born before the day before today.

clue.text: See 27
Make an appeal quietly to take the star part

parts.note: p is the musical marking piano, meaning quietly
the lead is the starring role

explanation.surface: Someone softly asks to be given the starring role.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or entreat earnestly, or to argue a case in court, is to appeal.
